name: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
headline: Sharpening tax: RL post-training narrows agent solution coverage
lede: Teams can measure how much solution coverage RL post-training costs them, and use temperature-adaptive sampling to reduce the loss.

effects.effect: Agent evaluation may need coverage metrics, not just single-shot accuracy
Post-training recipes may add adaptive sampling

possibilities.title: Teams post-training agents cheaply must measure what the RL stage costs in coverage

with.title: ByteDance Axion 1.0 shows a short agent post-train recipe

possibilities.connection: Axion's recipe makes agent post-training a roughly 90 GPU-hour supervised stage plus RL on about 18k samples, and the sharpening tax work shows RL can narrow solution coverage and offers temperature-adaptive sampling to reduce the loss.

appearances.title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
appearances.headline: Sharpening tax: RL post-training narrows agent solution coverage
appearances.newly_possible: Teams can measure how much solution coverage RL post-training costs them, and use temperature-adaptive sampling to reduce the loss.
appearances.why: If you tune agents with RL, single-shot accuracy gains may hide a loss in the range of solutions found.
appearances.limits: The paper reports the trade-off and a mitigation, but no code is linked in the input.
